note: Larkspur's bars for chapter 7, the team's choices, not any provider's. Each kind of reply is tried on its pinned phrases (data/diffusion-llms/prompts.json, by seed). A reply passes when at least `agree` of its 16 tokens match the careful fill (one slot a pass, surest first) and at most `repeat` tokens repeat the one before.

kinds.label: Customer answers
kinds.reason: Sent to customers as written: only the careful reply, token for token.

kinds.label: Release-note drafts
kinds.reason: An editor rewrites them, but stutters waste the editor’s time: at most 2 repeats.

kinds.label: Internal notes
kinds.reason: Staff skim them and want them fast: at most 5 repeats.
